title: loadng.c: Missing hop_limit validation allows malformed RREQ processing
description: Line 592: When processing an RREQ with hop_limit > LICHEN_LOADNG_MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15), the subtraction `LICHEN_LOADNG_MAX_HOP_LIMIT - rreq->hop_limit` produces a negative int value that becomes 255 after uint8_t cast. This creates routes with bogus hop_count=255 and metric=255. Additionally, line 641 forwards such packets, allowing a malformed RREQ with hop_limit=255 to propagate up to 255 hops through the network, wasting bandwidth. Input should be validated or capped before arithmetic.
